title: Local Consumer Review Survey 2026: Star Ratings Keep Rising, Old Reviews Don’t Cut It

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey, 97% of consumers read reviews for local businesses.
facts.quote: 97% of consumers read reviews for local businesses

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey, 41% of consumers said they 'always' read reviews when browsing for businesses, up from 29% the prior year.
facts.quote: In 2026, 41% of consumers “always” read reviews when browsing for businesses, a huge jump from last year (29%).

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 survey, the average consumer uses six different review sites when choosing businesses.
facts.quote: The average consumer uses six different review sites when choosing businesses

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 survey, Google's share as a review source dipped from 83% in 2025 to 71% in 2026.
facts.quote: this year its share has dipped from 83% in 2025 to 71%

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 survey, use of ChatGPT and other generative AI tools for local recommendations rose from 6% in 2025 to 45% in 2026, making it the third most popular source.
facts.quote: rising from 6% last year to 45% and becoming the third most popular source of business recommendations

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 survey, Apple Maps usage for reviews nearly doubled from 14% in 2025 to 27% in 2026.
facts.quote: Apple Maps _nearly doubled_ in usage from 14% in 2025 to 27%

facts.fact: In the BrightLocal 2026 survey, local news sites as a review source fell from 48% to 29%.
facts.quote: local news sites, which fell sharply from 48% to 29%
